_doc: Earth's talents, pass 1 (2026-10-11, the owner: "we need to make sure all the talents work and they work in game right"): earth.wall.thick (Thick Wall) is switched ON: tests/ring/test_talents_earth.gd raises it in a ring and shoots it down (5 hits from 4, 2.5 m wide from 3), worn and not worn. The behaviour talents built for earth are in `behaviour` (each id: where its code is), at the end of `live`, and on in `nodes`; the same test plays each worn and not worn.

The tuning talents (2026-10-11, the owner: "we need to make sure all the talents work and they work in game right"): Clean Return, Open Hands, Steady Point, Swift Lance, Heavy Boulder, Deep Roots, Swift Roots, Patient Turn, Lazy River, Rapids, Reaching Parry, Long Carry, Gale Force change a guard rule, a passive, a % ring rule or Stone Form's own number for the wearer (BendLoadout's tune part: each read where the game reads it for him). Live unsoaked; tests/ring/test_talents_tune.gd plays each worn and not worn in a ring.

What a worn Advancement loadout changes in a real match (BendLoadout; docs/tidebreak/loadouts_live.md). Read at every match start (RingMode.restart): the loadout worn for the player's element (AdvancementStore, read only) puts its live nodes' numbers and its live fighting style on the player's body; a bot never wears one. Classic (nothing worn) changes nothing.
enabled: the master switch. Off, no node number and no style applies anywhere. On is safe by default: with nothing worn every number is today's.

live: the node ids that may apply (the eight number-only nodes of the plan's B2, less those refused): air.ball.dense, air.gust.full_sail, air.slice.keen, earth.burrow.lie_low, fire.step.quick, earth.wall.thick, water.wall.thick_ice. Each node's numbers are read from data/sway/skill_tree.json changes[]; a node applies only when every change in it can be applied per wearer and the data still holds its `from`.

air.gust.full_sail is switched OFF (2026-10-10): the Gust held long became the Air Lance (a spear throw), so Full Sail now widens the plain Gust (2.4 m from 2, lock 0.5 s from 0.45) instead of the grown one; the soak measured the old numbers, and unverified is not live. Flip it to true once tools/ring/loadout_soak.gd element=air nodes=air.gust.full_sail is in the gate.

styles_live: the fighting styles whose clips play (state animated in data/bending/fighting_styles.json and poses in data/bending/style_poses.json). Boxing only; Capoeira is parked and never plays. A style is animation only: its picks are timed as the element's own (BendPoses._timed_as).

classic_style: false means a class picked with Classic worn (AdvancementStore.set_style, worn index -1) is not played: Classic plays exactly as before. true would play the picked class's clips (animation only) with no loadout worn.

fire.lightning.pistol (Lightning Pistol, 2026-10-11, the owner: "we want both moves the orignal one and the lightning pistol it will be a skill tree thing have this or that and each has it perks and cons"): fire's Storm twist. Worn, Lightning is cast from the game's standing pistol aim (its change pose:fire_arc/lightning, BendLoadout's pose overlay) and charges in 1.5 s (from 2.2), its flash 0.4 s before the strike (from 0.25); not worn, the original two-handed Lightning plays as before. Live on the owner's word for him to try; its numbers are starting values and have not been through the soak yet.

The class numbers (2026-10-11, the owner on the tree: "fix it"): a node's change class:<tag>+<variant>.<key> sets one number (d, base, growth, angle, set_stun; volley_n only beside the node's own spec count) of the % ring class of the wearer's own hits with that tag (BendLoadout's class part, RingRules.on_hit through BendLoadout.hit_class); the hit keeps its tag, so staling and the range exemption still see the move. That made nine more nodes whole, live on the owner's word and NOT yet through the soak (their numbers are the tree's starting values): earth.fissure.deep (Deep Fissure), water.spear.cold_hands (Cold Hands), water.spear.heavy (Heavy Spear), water.downpour.pooling (Pooling Downpour), fire.punch.snap (Snap Punch), fire.lightning.short_fuse (Short Fuse), fire.embers.tight (Tight Embers), air.palm.shoving (Shoving Palm), air.gust.rising (Rising Gust). water.mud.lash is not live: it requires the Mud set (new mud pools, not numbers) and its smother is not in its changes; a node whose required node is not live is refused (BendLoadout.why_not).

The binds (2026-10-11, the owner: "i think each element should have binds and finishers and how they build team comps is on them right?"; his answers: the feet only, as a skill tree twist, fire's a lightning shock): Stone Grip (earth.column.grip), Frost Geyser (water.geyser.frost), Static Shock (fire.lightning.shock) and Tripwind (air.pull.trip). Each sets its move's new spec key bind_s (from none: BendLoadout.NEW_SPEC_KEYS) to 0.7: its hit holds the feet (BendStatus.bind: no run, jump, roll, dodge or dash; aim, casts and the guard free; weaker each time on the same body, rules.json stock.bind) in place of its launch, and lowers its %. Live on the owner's word, not yet soaked.

Wind Prison (air.wall.prison) and Drenching Wave (water.wave.drench), 2026-10-11 (the owner: "air should have air prisons where they can catch someone mid flight and water should be able slowdown"; both as twists): spec keys Classic lacks, prison_s 1.0 (BendZone: the Wind Wall holds whoever it touches in the air, helpless, and turns no shot aside; its wall 4.5 m tall from 2.5, so it reaches a knock-up's float) and drench_s 1.5 (the Wave's hit soaks him: 30% slower, BendStatus.drench). Live on the owner's word, not soaked.

earth.catch.juggle (Juggle) is switched OFF (2026-10-12, earth fix): as its text reads it is a downgrade. Its plus, "Your Catch can hold two stones from one window. E throws the first, E again the second", is what the Classic Catch already does (it holds every stone of its window and E throws one each), so worn it only adds limits: a third stone is dropped at his feet as its thrower's loose stone, and his full catches end at 0.8 s (from 1.0). Its code is built and tested (tests/ring/test_talents_earth.gd turns it on with config_override) and waits for the owner's call on what its plus should be; until then a loadout that picks it applies nothing of it.

beat_on (2026-10-12, earth fix): the held casts ("move/mode") a Beat technique pays on (BendLoadout._beat_on, beat_paid(body, move, mode)). A built behaviour node whose new change says Beat pays on its own move and mode (the tree's "A <move> let go on the Beat": Heave's Column) unless this map names others: Quarry's is the Fissure it lets go into its wall; Return to Sender's is none (its Beat is the Catch's E again, BendZone.beat_return). Every other cast of the wearer gets no Beat: no flash, no click, no info.beat.

water.wall.thick_ice is switched ON (2026-10-11, the owner: "we need to make sure all the talents work and they work in game right"): tests/ring/test_talents_water.gd raises the wearer's Ice Wall in a ring and shoots it with ice: it rises in 0.8 s and falls at the 4th hit (Classic 0.7 s, the 3rd), a bot wearing it the same. That is a play test of its numbers, not a fairness measure: the soak still cannot see it (its bots never raise a wall unasked), so its win rate is unmeasured, as earth's Thick Wall's (switched on the same way in earth's lane).

water.splash.washout and water.turn.cleanse (2026-10-12) wait for earth.set.sulphur (their switch names it: BendLoadout.why_not, AdvancementData.is_live): both only wash gas, and the only gas in the game is the Sulphur set's (earth's lane, tb/talents-earth-p2), which a bot never wears; with no Sulphur set live a match never holds gas and the two would be their trades alone (Splash 3.5% for 4, Turn lock 0.24 s for 0.2). Live, they act on any gas zone (BendZone kind gas): the wearer's Splash and Lash wash a cloud they pass through and fly on (BendZone.washes), his standing Turn washes a cloud within its 2.2 m (BendZone._every redirect); everyone's Geyser washes the gas it rises in (BendEffects.spout, _wash_gas), the Wave's cone the Sulphur set's own (BendGas.cone). On merging earth's lane: its BendGas.react washes gas with ANY water bolt, which makes Washout's plus everyone's; the tree's Washed Ground synergy says only the Wave and Geyser do that for everyone, so its water branch should ask BendZone.washes(b) (Washout's wearer's Splash and Lash).

nodes: one switch per node id (absent counts as on; a node id in place of true: on while that node is live, BendLoadout.why_not). A node whose soak left its gate (tools/ring/loadout_soak.gd: 0.40-0.60 of the games at 30, 0.45-0.55 at 60) is switched off here and noted in the doc; its numbers then read as the move's own.

water.skate.wet_trail is live (2026-10-11): the Skate's puddles (puddles.count, puddles.life_s in data/sway/moves.json, made by nothing before) are laid for its wearer alone (BendEffects._wet_trail), so the node is whole: 4 puddles for 7.2 s spread along its slide (2026-10-12: one each WET_TRAIL_STEP_M slid, the last where it stops) and travel 10.8 m/s; Classic's Skate still leaves none (the node's 'from 3' is the data's dormant count). Earth's Steady Point is live too (2026-10-11, its own fields read per wearer).

earth.wall.thick and water.wall.thick_ice were switched OFF by the 2026-10-10 soak (tools/ring/loadout_soak.gd): the numbers apply and are tested, but the soak's bots never raise an Earth Wall or an Ice Wall (0 casts in 60 mirror games each; they only answer a held stone with one), so the fairness gate cannot see these two nodes. Their rates (Thick Wall 17/30 = 0.567, Thick Ice 23/60 = 0.383) are the mirror's own noise: with nothing worn the same seeds gave 18/30 for earth and, for water, exactly the games the node run played (9/30). Thick Ice is on again since 2026-10-11 (see the first line): played in a ring, a bot wearing it raising it, but still not soaked.

Fire's behaviour talents (2026-10-11, the owner: "we need to make sure all the talents work and they work in game right"; scripts/bending/fire_talents.gd, tests/ring/test_talents_fire.gd), live on that word and NOT soaked. The techniques' head starts (a lock begun within its window starts part full, never a whole lock): Hot Hands (a perfect Parry: the next Punch half full within 1 s), Two-Hand Rhythm (a Punch let go on the Beat, within 0.2 s of its click: the next Punch 30% full within 1 s), Chain Kicks (a Kick on the Beat: the next Kick 40% full within 0.6 s), Grounded Charge (a hit breaks the Lightning charge: the next Lightning half full within 1 s); the passives' fill: Hot Feet (standing still x0.9, on the move x1.1), Dancing Feet (on the move x0.9, x1.15 for 0.6 s after a Step ends). Then the floor fire and bursts (BendZone matter: % only, no_hurt, one tick each 0.5 s, capped, never its owner, jumped clear): Crescent Burn, Ignite Step, Scald, Blazing Fireball (its burst a whole new class, BendLoadout.new_hit_class); Curved Curtain, Forked Lightning (rules.json reaction/live), Hold the Storm; the Magma set and its four nodes (seams, matter/magma; Forge's set:magma.seam_life_s); Cauterize (Patch's key tapped twice, its spec in FireTalents, never in moves.json). A bot wearing one (a test) reads the same seams in NpcBending. Flashfire (pass 2): the gas it lights is earth's Sulphur set (a BendZone of kind gas, not built in fire's lane); fire lighting gas, the Ignited Sulphur burst (rules.json reaction/ignited_gas, owned by the lighter, 1.5x the cloud), is built in FireTalents.ignite for anyone's fire as a stand-in for earth's BendGas (it steps aside once that is merged; BendGas.ignite then adds FireTalents.flash_reach), so until Sulphur is built only its trade (Embers 6%) shows in a match. docs/tidebreak/loadouts_live.md has the table.

beat_on fire.punch.rhythm and fire.kick.chain [] (2026-10-12, the lanes' merge): fire's own Beat techniques pay through FireTalents.beat (the head start for the next Punch or Kick); the general Beat (BendLoadout.beat_paid: info.beat and the hand flash) leaves them alone, so a Rhythm or Chain release pays once.

behaviour.earth.catch.juggle: BendZone._take_stone / held_stone / held_stones (two held side by side, the oldest thrown first, a third dropped at his feet); window_s per wearer (the Catch's full catches: the game's own) and stock:guard_catch_s (RingRules.guard_outcome, the spec's reference, which no game code calls); switched off in nodes, waiting for the owner's call (see _doc)
behaviour.earth.catch.return_to_sender: BendZone.return_stone (a clean catch thrown back on the Beat x1.15: beat_return, lock_began); the Beat in SwayCaster (_beat_go) and NpcBending (_release, _answer_catch on the Beat); return_lock_s per wearer (guard_lock_s)
behaviour.earth.pebbles.kick_up: BendBolt._finish / _kick_up_end (a volley that met nobody leaves one loose stone where its last pebble lands; the Fissure's _heave_loose throws it on); spread per wearer (spec)
behaviour.earth.boulder.avalanche: GustLift._land / _avalanche (where the wearer's Boulder lands on the deck: three low rolling stone bolts fanned 15 deg, one volley of 3); FormEffects._one_boulder (the Boulder's own hit whole); BendZone catch (one of a volley held, the rest dropped at the catcher's feet); class base and volley_n per wearer
behaviour.earth.column.heave: the Beat (SwayCaster _beat_go, NpcBending._release: the hit's info beat) and BendLoadout.hit_class's class_beat (the node's class change, when beat: base 11.3 only on a Beat Column); Column lock 1.7 per wearer
behaviour.earth.stone.kiln_stone: BendZone.on_bolt (a stone bolt through a fire_wall or burn: BendBolt.heat) and GustLift._kiln_check (a hurled stone); BendLoadout.hit_class (info.heated: base x1.15); BendZone parry (perfect sends it back: _straight_back, _lift_back) and Turn (douse)
behaviour.earth.wall.rubble: FormRaised.crumble / _rubble_stones (shot down or capped: two loose stones of the raiser's at its foot); rise_s per wearer (wall_numbers)
behaviour.earth.wall.quarry: BendBolt._hit / _quarry (a Beat Fissure into his own wall: FormEffects.gust_chunk thrown on along the crack, the first chunk each wall free); the Beat (info.beat); rise_s per wearer (wall_numbers)
behaviour.earth.mend.reinforce: FormEffects.mend (a mended piece's brace 2: REINFORCE_N) and FormRaised.take_brace (BendBolt.wear, apply_hit: a counted brace); Mend's lock 2.6 per wearer (move:mend.lock_s, its one mode)
behaviour.earth.set.sulphur: scripts/bending/bend_gas.gd (BendZone gas: ticks, look, reactions; the Boulder's end GustLift._gas_end, stone clashes BendBolt.meet/meet_lift, GustLift._meet_lifts; bots step out NpcBending._move; pass 2: cones BendEffects.cone -> BendGas.cone, fire and wind walls BendZone._every -> BendGas.every, Live Gas BendEffects._strike -> BendGas.live, IGNITED! a RingHighlights moment); Pebbles class d per wearer
behaviour.earth.sulphur.spike: BendGas.stone_end (a puff where his Spike stops: GustLift._shatter/_land); class d per wearer
behaviour.earth.sulphur.boulder: BendGas.stone_end (three puffs along the Boulder's flight); class d per wearer
behaviour.earth.sulphur.fuming_column: BendEffects.column (a plume where the pillar rose: BendGas.make); class base per wearer
behaviour.earth.sulphur.brimstone_wall: FormRaised.crumble / _brimstone (shot down: a cloud 1 m out on the shooter's side); wall hits per wearer (wall_numbers)
behaviour.earth.sulphur.flint_pebbles: BendGas.react (his Pebbles light his own gas: ignite, his); set:sulphur.cloud_life_s per wearer (BendGas.num)
behaviour.earth.sulphur.heart: BendGas.home_mult (SwayCaster.passive_fill, NpcBending lock fill: x1.15 in his own gas, the higher with Rooted); set:sulphur.cloud_radius_m per wearer (BendGas.num)
behaviour.earth.sulphur.vent: a new skill, 4 tapped twice: earth_wall's talent mode vent (moves.json earth_wall.talent_bend.vent) through BendLoadout's new skills (modes_for: SwayCaster.my_modes, Bending.other_move, the hotbar's double tap; talent_spec: FormEffects.apply, BendCast.cast; talent_lock: SwayCaster._lock_time, NpcBending.lock_for; pose_mode: BendPoses.pick; talent_label); BendEffects.zone hands a gas zone to BendGas.vent (one at a time); a bot's option (NpcBending._build_options: talent_pairs, its spec's ai hint); rise_s per wearer (wall_numbers)
behaviour.water.splash.washout: BendZone.on_bolt gas (washes), BendZone.wash; the gas zone is the Sulphur set's (earth): its switch waits for earth.set.sulphur; everyone's Geyser washes gas too (BendEffects._wash_gas)
behaviour.water.lash.splashdown: BendBolt.end, _splashdown (a puddle where the Lash stops: a body, a raised wall, a zone's wall (BendBolt.zone_wall, BendZone.on_bolt fire_wall / water_wall), the deck)
behaviour.water.lash.steamcraft: BendBolt.meet, BendBolt.steam (life, drift), BendZone steam drift
behaviour.water.turn.cleanse: BendZone._every redirect (gas washed in its reach); its switch waits for earth.set.sulphur
behaviour.water.wave.pooling: BendEffects.cone, _wave_talents (a puddle where the cone ends)
behaviour.water.wave.ride: SwayCaster._cast (the Beat: BendR3.release beat, BendLoadout.beat_paid), BendEffects._wave_talents (BendLooks.beat_flash), BendMotion.ride / _ride_step (a knock ends it), NpcBending._on_beat (bend_ai.json beat_rate)
behaviour.water.skate.wet_trail: BendEffects.dash, _wet_trail (the Skate's puddles, the wearer's only, spread along the slide)
behaviour.water.set.mud: BendZone.make (his puddles mud pools), _mud_every (fire walls 2 s and the pool dried, seams quenched, rolling stones stopped), on_bolt mud (floor fire dies), mud_life
behaviour.water.mud.lash: BendBolt.meet (fire smothered, no steam), BendBolt.launch (clods); its numbers over the set's
behaviour.water.mud.mudslide: BendEffects._wave_talents (a 2 m mud pool where the cone ends)
behaviour.water.mud.mound: BendEffects.spout, _mud_mound (a low mud mound, 2 at once, never a wall: MOUND_META, no bend_by; BendEffects.is_mound for the readers of any raised wall: NpcBending._wall_on_line, the Shove's pick)
behaviour.water.mud.mire: a new mode on water_shield (4 tapped twice): BendLoadout.modes_added / new_spec (new:mire.spec), SwayCaster.modes_of / spec_of, Bending.other_move, FormEffects.apply, BendCast.cast, BendEffects.zone, BendZone.make (MIRE_META), BendPoses.pick (pose_as), NpcBending options (foe_floor_fire)
behaviour.fire.fireball.blazing: FireTalents.bolt_ended (BendBolt._finish), FireTalents.burst; its burst class through BendLoadout.new_hit_class (RingRules.on_hit)
behaviour.fire.set.magma: FireTalents.seam (BendZone seam: matter/magma), from FireTalents.bolt_ended (BendBolt._finish: the Kick's and the Axe Kick's waves); FireTalents.seam_water (BendZone._every)
behaviour.fire.magma.fist: FireTalents.bolt_ended (a seam where the grown bolt hits or lands)
behaviour.fire.magma.lava_kick: FireTalents.bolt_ended (the Kick's last 4 m one seam)
behaviour.fire.slot.cauterize: FireTalents.modes_for (Bending.other_move, SwayCaster.my_modes), FireTalents.patch_lock (SwayCaster._lock_time), FireTalents.cauterize (BendEffects heal; RingRules.patch_up_to, add_pct_kept); its spec FireTalents.own_spec (FormEffects.apply)
behaviour.fire.embers.flashfire: FireTalents.flash_reach (the Ignited Sulphur burst 1 m farther for the lighter who wears it; its class through BendLoadout.hit_class): the burst is FireTalents.ignite, lit by FireTalents.gas_bolt (BendZone.on_bolt), gas_cone (BendEffects.cone), gas_every (BendZone._every of a gas cloud), a stand-in that steps aside once earth's BendGas is merged (FireTalents.earth_gas; BendGas.ignite then adds flash_reach); a bot: FireTalents.bot_weight (NpcBending._choose)
